item.tib: srid rgyal zlog gzhung gi las kyi mtha' bsdud gtor zor 'ben byad
item.coloph: de ltar drag po'i mtshon zor 'dis/ dgra bgegs rtsad gcod brlag par 'gyur/ mtshan bcas mi dmigs rnam par dgastong nyid lta ba'i rgyas theb bya/ skal med pa yi spyod yul min/ dgongs ldan gshen gyi man ngag yin/ dam med rnams la gsang rgya tham/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin du/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pos/ yi ge ris su bris pa la/ nyes 'gal ci mchis lha la bshags/ dge mchis sems can don phyir bsngo/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu gyur cig sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
